We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We have guidance: step 1 forward: carboxylic acid to amide (coupling). So retrosynthetic: break amide bond to give carboxylic acid and amine.

Step 2 forward: Doebner modification: aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid -> alpha,beta-unsaturated carboxylic acid (the /C=C/C(=O)N part). So retrosynthetic: break the C=C double bond and the carboxylic acid to give aromatic aldehyde and malonic acid? Actually Doebner gives unsaturated acid from aldehyde + malonic acid. So reverse: from unsaturated acid we can get aldehyde + malonic acid.

Step 3 forward: sulfonamide formation: amine + sulfonyl chloride -> sulfonamide. So retrosynthetic: break sulfonamide to give sulfonyl chloride and amine.

Thus we need three steps: 1) amide bond formation (target has amide linking unsaturated acid to aniline). 2) formation of unsaturated acid via Doebner (target has unsaturated acid attached to aromatic ring). 3) sulfonamide formation linking sulfonyl chloride to aniline.

We need to produce JSON route with three reaction nodes each with template_id (we need IDs). We need to search for templates matching each transformation.

First, get available functional groups to know correct names.
